method.scoreRule: The disclosed Registry Outlook sky score is copied before market comparison. Market fields cannot alter that score or its wording.
method.observationRule: Follow-ups use the first archived market snapshot at or after the requested elapsed interval and report the actual elapsed time.
method.causalityRule: Market changes are observations, never evidence that a sky event caused a price or liquidity movement.
method.publicationRule: During the pilot, an exact artifact hash and named reviewer are required before an item enters public feeds.
